test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

If you don't water your houseplants, they __will dies__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **will die.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the **'dies' **is incorrect.
 
• After the modal** 'will',** the **base form of a verb** must be used.
 
 
• For example: I will do it.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this context, the base form of the verb must be used. Hence,** 'die'** is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *If you don't water your houseplants, they will **die***.
